data_fields.name: swift_learner_bonus_per_rank
data_fields.donor_constant: 5 (percent of the award per rank, integer division)

data_fields.name: kill_xp_per_foe
data_fields.donor_constant: 60 default in proto_critter_init; per-monster values not read

best_idea: Pay kill XP once per foe killed by the hero's own attack (only foes alive before that attack), then level up from a closed-form threshold table, granting the HP bump when the level is reached.
decision_why: The closed-form level table and the per-foe kill value fit a duel and a server ledger; the mid-fight HP grant and the combat-end accumulator do not fit as written (a max-HP change mid-fight, and a possible second credit for the same kill).
acceptance: A server test: one 60-XP foe killed by the hero's attack, Swift Learner rank 1, credits 63 XP once (a second foe already dead before the attack adds nothing); the HP grant applies at fight end; XP 999 is level 1 and XP 1000 is level 2.
